name: Document Role
description: Accountability roles recorded on a governing document — owner, approver, liaison, delegate, sponsor, key contact, monitor, partner (§2.2, §4.2). Distinct from access roles, which live in the permission engine.

fields.label: Code
fields.description: Stable identifier. Used by integrations and imports; do not reuse a retired code.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Inactive values stay on historical records but are not offered for new ones.

fields.label: Sort Order
fields.description: Presentation order where alphabetical is wrong.

fields.label: External Code
fields.description: The identifier this value carries in whatever system of record eventually owns it. Reserved now so a future reconciliation needs no migration. [Inferred — 02-data-model.md §11 I-2.]

fields.label: Accountable Role
fields.description: Whether the holder is accountable for the record rather than consulted on it.

fields.label: Can Attest
fields.description: Whether the holder receives a document attestation task.
